profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer- Reliability Engineering - Data & Analytics at The Home Depot

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Reliability Engineering - The Home Depot
Senior IT Developer
positions.description:
• Work as part of a select team to provide 24 X 7 software support for mission critical, high-volume (Java and database driven) Point of Sales (POS) system. Including support for .com, pro and special order sales.

• Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for sales tax sub-system; Maintain compliance between POS system and strict country-wide tax regulations; Develop and implement new programs and enhancements to existing programs. Implement, update and maintain Taxware systems for corporate sales tax calculation and compliance.

• Elicit and analyze functional requirements for break-fix projects and production issues; Translate functional requirements into technical requirements for implementation of technical solutions; Develop requirement and design specification documents. 

• Submit and implement process improvement strategies; Provide training; Develop and maintain tools, user guides, and technical documentation. Provide risk assessment and audit data for Sarbanes Oxley and other compliance efforts.

positions.title: Apprentice Machinist / Computer Technician
positions.description:
• Trained staff and customers in computer-system setup and operations.

• Developed the roles and responsibilities for Machine operators, machine programmers, quality assurance. Developed measures for success.

• CAD design of multiple custom parts for high end test and measurement equipment. CNC M-Code and G-Code Programming of machine code for production and prototype parts.

• Setup, maintained and operated various CNC machining centers; including the design and implementation of a serial network, linking Engineers and CAD Designers directly to the machines speeding up setup, run and production time for each part.

• Designed internal websites for EPSG division, streamlining order fulfillment process and internal communications.
